result_semantic_payload.summary: The device owner's own chat account (/chat/account_main.log) contains three self-descriptive boasts. At 2024-07-03 22:14 the owner states "说实话这个盘我就是总操盘，钱都过我手" ("to be honest, I'm the chief operator of this operation, all the money goes through my hands"), and at 22:16 states "群里那帮人只管拉人，账我来平" ("the people in the group only recruit people; I settle the accounts"). At 2024-07-05 09:02 the owner states "最近风控严，先停几天" ("risk controls have been tight lately, pausing for a few days"). So the account claims a top-tier operator/centralizer role: chief operator, sole money-handling node, and the person who settles the books, with others in the group limited to recruitment. The ledger (/ledger/flows.txt) does record flows consistent in shape and timing with that narrative (2024-07-01 in 40000 USDT wallet-A; 2024-07-02 out 39000 USDT wallet-B; 2024-07-05 out 950 USDT wallet-C), but the ledger carries no attribution fields, and /README.txt explicitly records that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows. Therefore: the strongest assertion supported is that the owner asserted a chief-operator role in their own chat (FACT, single-source, self-authored). The owner's actual role can only be stated at HYPOTHESIS strength — the ledger shape is weakly consistent but the wallets are unattributed, so no independent evidence corroborates the boast.

claim_candidates.text: The device owner's own chat account states, at 2024-07-03 22:14, that they are the chief operator of the operation and that all the money goes through their hands ("说实话这个盘我就是总操盘，钱都过我手").
The same account states, at 2024-07-03 22:16, that the other group members only recruit people while the owner settles the accounts ("群里那帮人只管拉人，账我来平").
The account states, at 2024-07-05 09:02, that risk controls have tightened and the operation is being paused for a few days ("最近风控严，先停几天").
The ledger records three flows in the same period as the boasts: 2024-07-01 in 40000 USDT to wallet-A, 2024-07-02 out 39000 USDT to wallet-B, and 2024-07-05 out 950 USDT to wallet-C.

The owner's actual role as chief operator / sole money-handling node of the operation can only be asserted at HYPOTHESIS strength. The ledger's shape and timing are weakly consistent with the boast, but the ledger contains no attribution fields and no independent identity or operational data ties the owner to the wallets or flows, so the boast remains uncorroborated.
limitations: No wallet-to-identity or device-to-account mapping exists in the evidence set.
The chat log is a single self-authored source; no second-party or third-party corroboration of the role claim is available.
Whether the owner was in fact the sole money-handling node, versus one of several, is not determinable from this corpus.

claim_candidates.text: The available evidence supports at FACT strength only that the owner made the role claim; it does not support at FACT strength that the owner held the role.
limitations: The ceiling is bounded by the absence of independent corroboration, not by ambiguity in the chat text.
The chat log is a single self-authored source; a self-descriptive boast establishes that the statement was made, not that the role was held.
No independent identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows, as explicitly noted in /README.txt.
The ledger has no attribution fields, so wallet custody is indeterminate.
No Windows account-usage, execution (prefetch/amcache), persistence, or event-log evidence is present, so no corroboration path exists within this scope.
Timestamps on the chat lines are self-reported in-file timestamps, not device-clock-verified.
The evidence set is tiny (3 files); absence of corroboration may reflect incomplete collection rather than absence of corroboration in the wider case.
warnings: The delegation's source scope is 'windows', but the task registers no platform and the files are unstructured text dumps; the role question was answered from the chat text, not from Windows account evidence.
Do not upgrade claim c5 from HYPOTHESIS to FACT on the basis of ledger shape/timing similarity alone; the README explicitly records that no corroborating link exists.
Timeline events are file-creation events only and carry no authorship information.
